page.overview:
Who is Maharaja Lallu?

Maharaja Lallu, simply referred to as the Maharaja in most media, is an Orient Expedition minifigure introduced in 2003.

Maharaja Lallu wears a white turban. His face is printed with grey hair poking out from under his turban; his hair stretches into a full, grey beard and moustache. He has two black eyes and a stern mouth. Lallu wears dark orange robes with ovular decorations. He has a red belt above his waist where a knife is tucked in.

In LEGO Rock Band, the Indian King lacks any facial hair and has black eyebrows, but is otherwise identical to Maharaja Lallu's physical minifigure.

Maharaja Lallu is a greedy and ruthless Indian tyrant who rules the Scorpion Palace and demands grain from the poor villagers. He joins forces with Lord Sam Sinister in search of Marco Polo's Golden Shield, a treasure that was hidden in the Scorpion Palace unbeknownst to Lallu.
